answer_1.quote: For each authentic human-written text, the texts generated by 7 SOTA LLMs ... are included by using three iterations of paraphrasing.

answer_2.quote: We have conducted linguistic analysis of the machine-generated texts along with the similarity comparison to human texts ... using METEOR, BERTScore, ngram, LD, MAUVE, and LangCheck.

answer_3.quote: we have used meta-evaluation utilizing LLM judges to compare the quality of the generated texts ... we have selected Gemma-2, Qwen2, and Llama-3.1 as meta-evaluators for judging quality of the texts
methods: LLM judges scoring on Linguistic Acceptability and Output Content Quality

answer_4.quote: Manual human check of the generated samples, revealed several problems of the approaches ... We have even conducted manual human check of the generated texts
answer_4.guideline: Identification of noise and model failures (e.g., phrases like 'As an AI model')
